children.textContent: FAQs About Life Coaching and Mental Wellness in Cuyahoga & Lorain County
I am dedicated to providing empathetic, evidence-based mental health support that is specifically tailored to the needs of each person.
What makes Moments With Mrs. T different from other life coaching services?
Our unique blend of empathy and professional certification fosters a supportive environment for personal growth and transformation.
Can coaching help with seasonal stress or winter depression?
Absolutely. Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD) is very real in Ohio. The

and constant gray skies in Cuyahoga and Lorain can deeply affect your mood. We help you build coping strategies that make you feel more grounded, energized, and emotionally balanced — no matter the season.
also helps reduce seasonal stress at home.
What if I don’t know where to start?

That’s perfectly OK. Our services are built for people who feel overwhelmed, unsure, or just need a starting point. Begin by scheduling a Free Consultation and we’ll help guide your path forward — without pressure or judgment.
We currently do not accept insurance, but our rates are affordable and flexible. We also offer
Is this service available in-person or online?
in person, and we also offer secure virtual sessions to make access easier — especially during tough Ohio winters when travel can be tough.
Do you offer family or group-based coaching?
Yes! Many of our clients find
more comforting and relatable. Family-based sessions are also available for improving communication, rebuilding trust, or healing after difficult times.
Do you help teens or only adults?

We work with all ages – adults, teenagers, and children – especially those navigating big changes, family conflict, or emotional overwhelm. Sessions are always adapted to fit the age and needs of the individual.
While every journey is unique, what we can guarantee is our
, honest feedback, and professional support every step of the way. Transformation takes time, and we’re with you for the long haul.
